metas.name: Ben 10
metas.description: The story of Ben Tennyson, a typical kid who becomes very atypical after he discovers the Omnitrix, a mysterious alien device with the power to transform the wearer into ten different alien species.

metas.name: Ben 10: Alien Force
metas.description: Fifteen-year-old Ben Tennyson must utilize the Omnitrix yet again in order to locate his missing Grandpa Max, accompanied by his cousin Gwen and former enemy Kevin 11.

metas.name: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien
metas.description: With his secret identity now revealed to the world, Ben Tennyson continues to fight evil as a superhero with the help of the newly acquired Ultimatrix.

metas.name: Ben 10: Omniverse
metas.description: The continuing adventures of Ben Tennyson (Yuri Lowenthal) and his new partner, Rook Blonko (Bumper Robinson).

metas.name: Adventure Time
metas.description: A 12-year-old boy and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old dog with magical powers, go on a series of surreal adventures in a remote future.

metas.name: Regular Show
metas.description: The surreal misadventures of two best friends--a blue jay and a raccoon--as they seek to liven up their mundane jobs as groundskeepers at the local park.

metas.name: Dexter's Laboratory
metas.description: The misadventures of a boy genius and his annoying sister.

metas.name: The Powerpuff Girls
metas.description: Three super-powered little girls constantly save the world (or at least the city of Townsville) from monsters, would-be conquerers and a few other gross things.

metas.name: Courage the Cowardly Dog
metas.description: The offbeat adventures of Courage, a cowardly dog who must overcome his own fears to heroically defend his unknowing farmer owners from all kinds of dangers, paranormal events and menaces that appear around their land.

metas.name: Ed, Edd n Eddy
metas.description: The off-the-wall, day-to-day life of three friends who have exactly the same name.

metas.name: Johnny Bravo
metas.description: The misadventures of a dumb blond egomaniac who severely overestimates his own manliness and his supposed "success" with women.

metas.name: Samurai Jack
metas.description: A samurai, sent through time, fights to return home and save the world.

metas.name: Teen Titans
metas.description: A team of five teenaged superheroes save the world from many villains around their city while experiencing things normal teens face.

metas.name: Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends
metas.description: A boy and his beloved imaginary friend are able to stay together at an orphanage of sorts for imaginary friends that children have outgrown to be adopted by new children.

metas.name: The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy
metas.description: The ill-tempered Grim Reaper gets into a wager that forces him to become the life-long companions of two scheming youngsters after he loses.

metas.name: Codename: Kids Next Door
metas.description: The adventures of a group of ten-year-old friends who fight for the right to do everything that adults restrict from them.

metas.name: The Amazing World of Gumball
metas.description: The life of a twelve-year-old boy who happens to be a blue cat as he lives with his family and other strange creatures.

metas.name: Steven Universe
metas.description: A team of intergalactic warriors fight to protect the Earth, but the combination of three highly trained beings and one quirky young boy leaves the team struggling to overcome the dangerous scenarios that they face.

metas.name: We Bare Bears
metas.description: Three bear brothers do whatever they can to be a part of human society by doing what everyone around them does.

metas.name: Chowder
metas.description: In Marzipan City, excitable young food-loving Chowder is the apprentice of Mung Daal, a very old chef who runs a catering company with his wife Truffles and assistant Shnitzel.

metas.name: Over the Garden Wall
metas.description: Two brothers find themselves lost in a mysterious land and try to find their way home.

metas.name: Infinity Train
metas.description: Various people get trapped on a mysterious train with an endless number of cars, each one being its own universe, and they must resolve their psychological trauma and emotional issues in order to get home in this animated antholog...

metas.name: Generator Rex
metas.description: In a future where humans are infected by untested, microscopic robots, a young man with the ability to control the bots helps a government agency control the tech's vicious creations.

metas.name: Total Drama
metas.description: Animated satire of survivor reality shows featuring random teenage archetypes vying for the final prize by any means necessary.

metas.name: The Marvelous Misadventures of Flapjack
metas.description: The comical seafaring adventures of a young, enthusiastic boy, his pirate captain mentor, and the talking whale that raised him from birth.

metas.name: Clarence
metas.description: Life is just one big adventure for Clarence and his two best friends, Jeff & Sumo.

metas.name: Camp Lazlo!
metas.description: Bean Scout Lazlo, a fun-loving, free-spirited monkey, and his two bunkmates Raj and Clam, wreak havoc on a very structured summer camp.

metas.name: Cow and Chicken
metas.description: The program focuses on the misadventures of two unlikely yet somehow biological siblings: Cow and Chicken.

metas.name: I Am Weasel
metas.description: The adventures of a highly intelligent, talented and rather generous weasel and a stupid baboon who has no talent at most things.

metas.name: Megas XLR
metas.description: Two teenage slackers find a mecha from the future that had been lying in a New Jersey junkyard for nearly 60 years and make modifications much to the dismay of the robot's attractive creator.

metas.name: Sym-Bionic Titan
metas.description: Three young alien beings with the ability to form a giant robotic warrior attempt to blend into suburbia, all while battling the tyrannical forces that ravaged their home world.

metas.name: Craig of the Creek
metas.description: Craig of the Creek follows a young boy, Craig, and his two friends, Kelsey and JP, as they go on adventures within a world of untamed, kid-dominated wilderness in the creek.
